news.title: Inaugural Boston Pharmacy Trek Provides Experiential Career Preparation for Butler Students
news.summary_en: This spring, 16 Butler University Pharmacy students participated in the first-ever Boston Pharmacy Trek, a donor-funded experiential learning trip made possible by Christina and Thomas Grusecki.
